title: WhatsApp Catalogue Guides and How-Tos | OneCatalog
description: WhatsApp catalogue guides for small shops: fix a catalog that is not showing, prices, approval, bulk upload and categories, and make a better catalogue.
h1: WhatsApp catalogue guides for shop owners
answer: These WhatsApp catalogue guides help shop owners fix common problems with the WhatsApp Business catalog and make a better product catalogue. Every step about WhatsApp's own app is checked against WhatsApp's help centre, and each guide lists its sources.
waText: Hi OneCatalog, I have a question about my WhatsApp catalogue.

cards.title: WhatsApp Business catalog not showing? 7 fixes
cards.text: Pending review, rejected items, hidden items and the known display issue.

cards.title: WhatsApp Business catalog price not showing
cards.text: The Price field, country limits and connected catalogs.

cards.title: WhatsApp Business catalog approval time
cards.text: What WhatsApp reviews, how long it says it takes, and how to appeal.

cards.title: WhatsApp Business catalog bulk upload
cards.text: The spreadsheet route through Meta Commerce Manager.

cards.title: How to add a catalog to WhatsApp Business
cards.text: Step by step for Android and iPhone.

cards.title: WhatsApp catalogue categories
cards.text: Create and manage collections, with example category names.

cards.title: How to make a product catalogue
cards.text: Seven steps from choosing products to sharing the link.

blocks.p: OneCatalog builds catalogue websites for small businesses, from photos and prices sent on WhatsApp. It works alongside the WhatsApp Business catalog. Read the comparison on our [WhatsApp catalogue page](/whatsapp-catalogue) or see the [plans and prices](/pricing).
